policy.sampling_policy: same frozen policy identity across arms and samples
policy.blinding_protocol: opaque sample IDs; mapping inaccessible to evaluators until judgment freeze

fresh_evaluator_policy.allowed_after_freeze: main engineering/orchestration context may reveal mapping and perform engineering evaluation
fresh_evaluator_policy.evaluator_outputs: dimension-level judgments, evidence references, uncertainty; no arm identity guess

policy.aggregation_rule: per dimension, take the median ordinal relation only when both evaluators agree on direction or at least 4 of 6 evaluator-by-batch votes support it; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
policy.non_inferiority_rule: zero critical B regressions and minimum support on every critical dimension; no scalar compensation
policy.generalization_limit: character-heavy only; does not authorize other demand classes or production cutover
